jobs.name: instagram-stories-3x-day-pt
jobs.prompt:
Publish next Instagram Story from queue for @kiraliluna.

Steps:
1. Check if photos exist in ~/.hermes/profiles/instamodel/stories_queue/
2. If queue is empty, exit silently (no notification)
3. If photos exist, run: python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/publish_story.py
4. Report: filename published, Media ID, remaining in queue

If token expired (error 190), report URGENT: "Page Access Token expired. Need new token."
If permission error (code 10), report: "App permission issue. Need review."
